plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.07 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a tentative measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 0.18 mag is normal for a star, not a cold brown dwarf.
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a M8 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (sdM9.5) fits clearly worse.
